card.name: Start of split words like Fractures
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer medical word that is split up, mostly "Fr" at the start of the heading "Fractures" after a section number such as 5.7. Also "oc", "contr" and "her" at the start of occlusion, contraindications and therapeutic.

modes.label: Fractures heading
modes.description: "Fr" opening the word Fractures in a numbered warnings section heading or summary line.

modes.label: Other split medical words
modes.description: The opening piece of words like occlusion, contraindications or therapeutic.
